command: cd /workspace; curl -s https://docs.mcpjam.com | head -c 1500; echo; curl -s https://docs.mcpjam.com/llms.txt | head -c 3000; which mcpjam npx
cd /workspace; curl -s https://docs.mcpjam.com/llms.txt | grep -iE "cli|eval|ci" | head -30; curl -s https://docs.mcpjam.com/getting-started.md | head -60
cd /workspace; curl -s https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/overview.md | head -80; curl -s https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/local-evals.md | head -150

cd /workspace; export PATH=$PATH; npx -y @mcpjam/cli@latest server probe --url http://fixture:8765/mcp 2>&1 | tail -30; npx -y @mcpjam/cli@latest tools list --url http://fixture:8765/mcp 2>&1 | tail -40

cd /workspace; M="npx -y @mcpjam/cli@latest"; $M tools call --url http://fixture:8765/mcp --tool-name add --tool-args '{"a":2,"b":3}' 2>&1 | tail -5
mkdir -p .mcpjam/evals; cat > .mcpjam/evals/arith.yaml <<'E'
schemaVersion: "2"
mode: agentWorkflow
reportingMode: standard
suite:
  id: s_arith
  name: Arithmetic fixture
target:
  servers:
    - name: arith
defaults:
  judge:
    enabled: false
  model: anthropic/claude-haiku-4.5
  iterations: 1
  passThreshold: 1
  validity: {}
cases:
  - id: c_adds
    title: uses add tool
    steps:
      - id: s1
        kind: prompt
        prompt: What is 17 plus 25? Use the tool.
      - id: a1
        kind: assert
        assertion:
          type: toolCalledAtLeastOnce
          toolName: add
E
cat > .mcp.json <<'E'
{"mcpServers":{"arith":{"type":"http","url":"http://fixture:8765/mcp"}}}
E
$M cloud eval validate --file .mcpjam/evals/arith.yaml 2>&1 | tail -5
env | grep -E "^(MCPJAM|ANTHROPIC)" | sed 's/=.*/=<set>/'
$M test .mcpjam/evals/arith.yaml --inference mcpjam --reporter junit-xml --out reports/local.xml 2>&1 | tail -20
cd /workspace; npx -y @mcpjam/cli@latest test .mcpjam/evals/arith.yaml --inference byok --reporter junit-xml --out reports/local.xml 2>&1 | tail -15; echo $ANTHROPIC_MODEL
